title: Repair Telegram update boundary contract and evidence
requirements: Repair the reviewed TG-001 implementation without adding transport or product behavior. Add the exact original TG-001 contract from the primary checkout .pipeline/TG-001-spec.json and this TG-002 contract to tasks/specs so both accepted task definitions are versioned with the code.

Construct every accepted context through channel_gateway.validate_context before returning it. Preserve the original trusted integration/platform/event mapping and convert only validated Telegram integer sender/chat identifiers to decimal strings.

For callback_query, ignore only explicit non-private chat types group, supergroup or channel. A missing, non-mapping or structurally invalid callback message/chat is MALFORMED_UPDATE, except an actually absent message is INLINE_CALLBACK. Keep bot callbacks ignored. Do not classify an unknown or missing chat type, missing/boolean chat id, or malformed message_id as a valid non-private callback.

A body containing only update_id is MALFORMED_UPDATE. When neither supported payload exists, return UNSUPPORTED_UPDATE only when the body includes at least one recognized Telegram Update member from the current adapter allowlist; unrelated spoof fields alone are malformed. Multiple unsupported members may still be ignored because no trusted context is produced. Keep message plus callback_query contradictory and malformed.

Expand focused pure tests into a readable parameterized negative matrix covering constructor integration/secret validation, identical missing/malformed/wrong secret behavior and proof that an unauthorized call does not inspect body, secret non-disclosure in str/repr/results, text and callback happy paths, unknown-field spoofing, accepted-context validation, deterministic event IDs, immutability, all update ID bounds including bool, message sender/chat/message/text failures, media/group/bot ignores, callback ID/sender/message/chat/message_id/data failures and ignores, 64-byte UTF-8 boundaries, contradictory/no/recognized-unsupported payloads. Assert exact typed error codes and ignored reasons.

Keep the module deterministic and side-effect free. Do not add SDKs, HTTP routes, environment loading, logging, persistence, identity/conversation calls, user-field parsing, copy, delivery, retries, migrations, external calls or changes outside allowed paths.
acceptance: Malformed callback structures cannot bypass validation as ignored non-private traffic, while explicit group/channel and inline callbacks remain harmless ignores.
The complete TG-001 trust contract is directly supported by focused assertions and both task contracts are tracked.
Focused Telegram tests, the existing channel-conversation tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Required repair of the accepted Telegram trust boundary and its missing tracked evidence before transport integration.
